notes.title: Chapter 3 Now Available
notes.content: [p]Play the all new [b]3rd chapter[/b]! Enjoy the biggest mall in Japari Park with Serval and Ezo Red Fox, meet new Friends like Humboldt Penguin and Royal Penguin, learn more about Anubis and Cerberus, see the girls dress up in cute outfits, and help Hululu overcome her past trauma.[/p][p][/p][p]As a Caretaker, it's your job to help the Friends of Japari Park stay happy and healthy. This is no easy task however, and that's why, starting with this chapter, [b]it will be possible to fail[/b] to help the main girl of the chapter.[/p][p][/p][p]If you make the wrong choice, you will get that chapter's bad ending, [b]but it won't be game over[/b]. You will move on to the next chapter no matter the ending you get. Your number of good endings and bad endings is what will determine what happens in the final chapter of the game.[/p][p][/p][p]If you get the bad ending for chapter 3, [b]you are welcome to reload your save[/b] and try again for the good ending.[/p]

notes.title: Simplified Chinese Translation Added
notes.content: Hello everyone! We're happy to announce that the 1st and 2nd chapters of Kemono Friends Opening Day are now available in Simplified Chinese. Thank you to everyone who contributed to the translation!

notes.title: Chapter 2 Now Available!
notes.content:
[b]Chapter 2 Now Available![/b]
Continue the story with the all new 2nd chapter! Meet your new robot friend Lucky Beast, visit a zoo with Nana, Serval, and Ezo Red Fox, have a snowball fight in an underground research facility, and learn the reason behind Ezo Red Fox's unkind behavior towards the protagonist girl.

[b]Update Notes[/b]
Updated game to include chapter 2 and fix old issues with the demo version. 

Please note that old save files are not completely compatible with the new version of the game and may cause glitches with the user interface.

To enjoy the new content without issues, we strongly recommend that you start a new game and use the skip button (Control on PC, Command on Mac) to skip to chapter 2.

Please also ignore any error message you may see about maliciously constructed save files. For some reason, the current version of the game does not recognize old saves as having been created by the player.
